These include commentators and quoted accounts, not just official teams.
180 repository paths scanned; 20 selected commit records inspected. Primary release, PR state, SN78 API, SN116 portfolio, SN108 leaderboard and service health checked separately.

Signed-in AlphaGap feed and leaderboard, SubnetRadar news and dated Moments, TAO Daily, TAO Media and partner sources checked. Current market outliers and the top 12 emission recipients were reviewed separately from account counts.

September 28–October 4 editions reviewed for duplicates, late findings, unresolved incidents and scheduled events. Conference recaps, documentation changes and merged code were not treated as completed production launches.

Signed-in YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked. Public wallet guide PQ7gRxDG1Sg and October 4 members video M2nWtKAkw6I verified; missing September 29 members video FqFmRffEgVU recovered. Current SN49 replay remains listed, with no new scheduled livestream found.

An overlapping pass of 18 priority public profiles ended at 2026-10-05T15:05:58.257Z; its newest SN118 business post repeats the September 30 conference announcement. Subsequent primary and signed-in follow-ups extend this edition’s research cutoff to 2026-10-05T15:10:26.683Z.
accessGaps: Research cutoff 2026-10-05T15:10:26.683Z. Full-roster collection started around 14:55 UTC; subsequent targeted checks and overlap continued to the cutoff. Associated public-account samples and focused signed-in searches are not an exhaustive search of every SN/name. No Grok scan is claimed.

13 repository paths returned errors and 10 public-account candidates returned no usable sample. Directory metadata can be stale; SN26 repository attribution remains uncertain. Guessed chrono_llm, umi_vision and sundae_bar search aliases are not claimed as official identities; confirmed chronollm, umi_sn78 and sundaebar_ai sources were separately identified.

Generated channel briefs and AlphaGap summaries are discovery evidence. Team-attributed scoring changes and incident responses remain developing without original-speaker or live-rollout confirmation; member-only accusations were excluded.

SN116 Carbon’s live announcement and proposed eight-challenge portfolio are directly available, but rewarded mining, customer deployments and commercial savings were not independently demonstrated. Its apparent returns cross the slot’s pre-registration history and are not a Carbon performance record.

SN41 Almanac and SN74 Gittensor measurements were not independently reproduced. SN80 OpenRoboto’s published allocation is verified documentation; its applied on-chain split was not reconstructed. SN38 ChronoLLM’s Round 14 PR remains open.

SN78 UMI is accepting intake but the checked API still marks rewards inactive and chain submission unauthorized. SN120 Affine accounting changes and operator recovery records are not independently reconstructed wallet payments or proof of improved learning.

SN118 Ditto reward recovery, SN11 TrajectoryRL missing-reward reports, SN44 Score warmup failures, SN15 ORO’s separate Race 11 pause and SN54 Yanez UAV payments are not independently closed. SN61 RedTeam replacement and SN114 SOMA review remain prospective.

SN108 ChipForge’s leaderboard has no active challenge and reports all validator stake burning at observation. SN22 Desearch’s October 5 task/burn target and SN121 sundae_bar’s October 5–6 challenge target are not confirmed complete. SN111 Claims burn proposal, SN65 diligence, SN104 launch, SN94 permissionless access, SN122 dashboard and SN25 production qualification remain gated.

SN106 Nodexo sale discussions do not establish a completed ownership transfer. SN113 LongShort’s outlier move lacks a confirmed new team or matched transfer. SN21 AdTAO’s latest lock amount was not independently matched; SN49 Nepher Robotics’s sourced lock is not evidence of a new purchase.

Members-only uploads require YouTube membership access and were not bypassed. Public guide metadata rounds duration to 625 seconds, while the visible player shows 10:24; the site uses the player duration. No new livestream schedule was found.

decisions.reason: The apparent +1233.553808% day and +1199.377969% week alpha/TAO changes cross the pre-registration slot history. The actual October 4 launch announcement and October 5 proposed portfolio are covered, without claiming an organic Carbon return or hypothetical savings as revenue.

The +31.634162% day and +29.131570% week alpha/TAO move triggered a focused signed-in SN113/LongShort search and associated TensorUSD-account review. Current posts are market recaps; the channel has no confirmed new team or matched completed ownership transfer. Price alone does not identify a fresh material catalyst.

editorialDecisions: SN116 launch at 18:26 UTC October 4 is fresh because it follows the preceding 17:49:42 cutoff. Eight challenges are proposed research with conditional illustrative customer benefits; no 8 customers, revenue sum, completed tests or real +1200% return is asserted.

SN80 new 35% egocentric allocation and 0.2 TAO simulation fee are verified documentation. October 5 Open Axis post quotes the October 2 September recap; no newly launched partnership or new physical season is inferred. September 27 physical-season result remains yesterday’s story.

SN4 cloud/B300, SN53 partnership and SN8 external revenue were previously covered. SN107 Q&A and SN3 single-GPU experimental evaluation are not newly verified product/commercial milestones.

SN108 actual UI: no running challenge, no submissions, 100% stake burning from 3 of 3 validators, chain snapshot synced approximately two minutes earlier. Primary team leaderboard and NPU testing update is covered; intended October 5 competition activation remains unconfirmed. TatsuOS end-to-end testing is not beta deployment.

SN22 official post is a builder question, not evidence today’s more-tasks/lower-burn release is live. SN121 SBC30 revised-scoring target October 5–6 remains prospective; no matching activation in public code or account sample. SN124 October 7–8 World Summit AI appearance remains upcoming, not new contracts.

SN49 lock 46,436.627 alpha at block 9215815, October 5 09:33 UTC, is covered without an owner motive or purchase claim. SN116 description-only spelling/case change is not an ownership event. Routine SN120 300-TAO, SN24 319-TAO, SN33 318-TAO and SN95/SN103/SN55 wallet movements do not alone establish a new business milestone; no motive or exit generalized from clusters.

SN21 second weekly lock is a direct team report with the linked portfolio, but exact event matching and amount remain gaps. SN34 historical king correction and tomorrow’s holdout change are below standalone threshold. SN85 UID202 removal and SN100 TestFlight, SN90 leakage fixes and SN113 handover remain member-only or lack team confirmation. SN12/SN36/SN95 allegations excluded.

Sources: https://www.natix.network/blog/progress-update-natix-network-july-2026 and https://lmb-freiburg.github.io/orbis2.github.io/. Stillcore October 4 paper is covered as published investment research, not a forecast guarantee, new revenue tally or instruction to buy. Brandtensor introduction is explicitly dated September 25 with October 4 interview follow-up. No unrelated StonkFun holders, token pairs, platform revenue, TRX/ZEC posts or generic market/political hype selected.
No story meets the five-star threshold. September 27 hourly X-post permission expired that day; no X post made during this update.

M2nWtKAkw6I October 4 members, 611-second metadata; September 29 missing members FqFmRffEgVU 553 seconds. Previous October 2 member retained, public guide is default, no new scheduled stream.
